title: Evidence Synthesis, Contradiction, External Challenge, Decision Translation And Reevaluation Registry
scope: Thirty-two inactive result-synthesis input dockets, eight inactive synthesis-contradiction dossiers, eight inactive external challenge-response dockets, and eight inactive decision-translation and reevaluation registers for the Phase 73 result layer.
interpretation_boundary: An adjudicated result is not a body of evidence. Convergence is not independence. A synthesis is not a decision recommendation. A recommendation is not authorization or an operating outcome. Contradictions, challenges, dissent, corrections, sunset rules, and reevaluation duties cannot be hidden or automated.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Adjudicated result identity
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: The exact Phase 73 result, adjudication receipt, current public lineage, and correction status are present.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Question, population, and setting
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: The research question, population, geography, setting, and eligibility boundary are explicit.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Measure, estimand, and scale
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: The outcome definition, unit, denominator, contrast, estimand, direction, and effect scale are compatible or explicitly transformed.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Intervention or exposure identity
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: The intervention, exposure, implementation version, intensity, timing, and comparison condition are exact.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Time basis and follow-up
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: The baseline, observation window, follow-up, lag, cadence, and event-time basis are visible.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Design and identification class
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: The design, identification assumptions, assignment process, controls, and inferential class remain attached.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Input provenance and independence
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: Sources, cohorts, samples, operators, code, environments, and shared dependencies are resolved before any independence claim.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Uncertainty and practical magnitude
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: Intervals, uncertainty sources, precision, practical magnitude, and inability to distinguish effects are explicit.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Deviation and amendment lineage
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: All protocol deviations, amendments, timing, materiality, and impacts on the estimand remain visible.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Robustness and falsification
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: Sensitivity, falsification, negative-control, placebo, and failure-test records accompany the result.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Null, adverse, and disconfirming evidence
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: Nulls, harms, reversals, warnings, exclusions, and disconfirming findings are preserved.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Replication and reproducibility
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: Independent and non-independent replications, disagreements, and unresolved reproduction failures are distinguished.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Bounded claim and correction readiness
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: The adjudicated claim class, exact public language, limitations, corrections, supersession, and withdrawal duties are current.

synthesis_eligibility_gates.label: Dual eligibility review and receipt
synthesis_eligibility_gates.question: Two independent reviewers issue a bounded synthesis-input decision and propagate its receipt to every assigned surface.

synthesis_gates.label: Synthesis question and scope lock
synthesis_gates.question: The body-level question, population, intervention or exposure, comparison, outcome, period, and exclusions are registered before synthesis.

synthesis_gates.label: Complete eligible-result set
synthesis_gates.question: Every eligible, null, adverse, corrected, withdrawn, and excluded result is enumerated with reasons.

synthesis_gates.label: Study and provenance independence
synthesis_gates.question: Shared cohorts, sources, operators, code, assumptions, funders, and institutional dependencies are mapped.

synthesis_gates.label: Measure and estimand compatibility
synthesis_gates.question: Measures, denominators, contrasts, estimands, scales, directions, and transformations are compared without silent harmonization.

synthesis_gates.label: Design diversity and inferential limits
synthesis_gates.question: Design classes and identification assumptions are kept visible rather than pooled into a stronger claim class.

synthesis_gates.label: Direction and consistency
synthesis_gates.question: Agreement, reversal, nulls, and discordance are assessed without vote counting.

synthesis_gates.label: Magnitude and practical importance
synthesis_gates.question: Effect magnitudes, thresholds, baselines, and practical importance are compared on defensible scales.

synthesis_gates.label: Uncertainty and precision
synthesis_gates.question: Within-result and body-level uncertainty, imprecision, missingness, and unresolved intervals remain explicit.

synthesis_gates.label: Heterogeneity and transfer limits
synthesis_gates.question: Population, setting, timing, implementation, and contextual heterogeneity constrain transfer.

synthesis_gates.label: Null, adverse, and omitted evidence
synthesis_gates.question: Null, adverse, disconfirming, unpublished, and missing-result risks are assessed.

synthesis_gates.label: Bias, deviations, and corrections
synthesis_gates.question: Selection, measurement, model, reporting, deviation, correction, and withdrawal risks affect the body-level decision.

synthesis_gates.label: Triangulation and replication portfolio
synthesis_gates.question: Independent methods, replications, mechanisms, and negative evidence are distinguished from repeated use of one dependency.

synthesis_gates.label: Evidence grade and bounded synthesis language
synthesis_gates.question: The evidence grade, uncertainty, contradictions, dissent, and verb strength support the exact proposed sentence.

synthesis_gates.label: Dual synthesis adjudication and receipt
synthesis_gates.question: Two independent reviewers issue one synthesis decision and complete challenge, correction, and propagation readiness.

contradiction_categories.label: Intervention, exposure, comparison, or implementation version
Source, cohort, operator, code, or shared dependency

challenge_review_gates.label: Standing, expertise, conflict, and funding disclosure
Omitted, null, adverse, or contradictory evidence
Revision, correction, withdrawal, or no-change decision
Dual review, reader notice, receipt, and propagation

decision_translation_gates.label: Current synthesis claim and evidence grade
Uncertainty, scenarios, and value of information
Dual translation review, receipt, and propagation
